title: Light Review Result
description: Return of the lens agent in a light review: the pb key it was given, any open question for the human, what it could not check, the focus changes it made and its findings, each tagged with a focus

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: Only a question a human must answer before the work can be trusted, phrased as a question, in plain words to the human, or null. What you could not read or check goes in not_checked, and an explanation of a finding goes in the finding, never here

ambiguity_options.description: Up to three short answers you suggest for your ambiguity, which the human may pick instead of typing one. Leave it out when you have no ambiguity or no likely answer

not_checked.description: What the review could not read or check, so the review does not cover it, or null. It goes to the report, never to the gate

reason.description: Why the focus was added or dropped

focus.description: The focus the finding was found through

title.description: The gist of the finding in at most 60 characters, like a commit subject

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences, grounded in evidence the agent read

where.description: A file path with an optional line, or the subject item
